sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
sections.description: Prohibits the production, manufacture, possession, sale, purchase, transport, storage, use, consumption, import, export and transshipment of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances except for medical or scientific purposes as permitted under the Act.

sections.title: Punishment for Opium Poppy and Opium Offences
Punishment for Cannabis
sections.description: Applies to cannabis offences including ganja and hashish.

sections.title: Punishment for Manufactured Drugs
sections.description: Applies to manufactured narcotic drugs such as heroin and cocaine.

sections.title: Punishment for Psychotropic Substances
sections.description: Applies to psychotropic substances including MDMA and methamphetamine.
